_description: Qwen3.6 35B A3B (IQ4_XS) — local llama.cpp deployment for agentic tool-calling workloads. Successor to qwen35; the default local executor in UAP routing. Routes through the anthropic-proxy (:4000) for <think>-stripping + tool/finalize guardrails.

dynamic_temperature._comment: On retry, temp = max(floor, base_temp * decay^attempt). Reduces randomness for structured output.

tool_call_batching.system_prompt_suffix: When multiple tools are needed, call ALL of them in a single response. Do not call one tool and wait - emit all tool calls together.
tool_call_batching._comment: Reduces round-trips by encouraging multi-tool emission in one turn.

structured_output._comment: GBNF grammar for per-request use only. Do NOT use --grammar-file on server startup — it forces tool_call output on all requests including plain chat. llama.cpp's autoparser handles tool call detection lazily via the chat template.

speculative_decoding._comment: ngram-mod self-speculation (no draft model). Draft-model spec crashes on the Qwen3.x hybrid memory (GDN) seq_add path; ngram-mod avoids this and gives stable throughput.

server_optimization._comment: KV q8/q4 split saves ~60% KV VRAM. Flash attn gives 1.5-2x speed on long context.

routing._comment: Route through the anthropic-proxy (:4000), NOT llama :8080 directly — the proxy strips <think> blocks and applies the tool/finalize guardrails.

quantization_profiles._comment: Each step up requires ~4-7GB more VRAM but improves instruction following.

running_config.description: Dual-model llama.cpp setup: Qwen3.6 35B A3B for LLM + nomic-embed-text-v2-moe for embeddings. Run as two separate llama-server instances on different ports; the LLM is fronted by the anthropic-proxy on :4000.

llm_server.description: Instance 1: Main LLM (Qwen3.6 35B A3B) — port 8080, fronted by the proxy on :4000
